name_reason: Name correctly reflects purpose and datatype: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), audio_bgm_ domain (BGM), sequence_handle = the AIL/Miles Sound System HSEQUENCE handle. Confirmed by writer main@0x25C26 (handle = AIL_allocate_sequence_handle(driver_handle)) and all readers in fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade passing it as the sequence arg to AIL_set_sequence_volume / AIL_stop_sequence / AIL_init_sequence / AIL_start_sequence / AIL_set_sequence_loop_count, plus one read in fd2_game_options_menu_loop. No Ghidra address residue; no domain ID to preserve.
purpose: AIL (Miles Sound System) sequence handle used for all BGM playback; allocated once at startup and passed to every AIL sequence call.
logic_summary: Written once in main (handle = AIL_allocate_sequence_handle(data_fd2_audio_bgm_driver_handle)) only when the MDI driver installed successfully. Thereafter it is an opaque 4-byte handle handed to AIL_set_sequence_volume / AIL_stop_sequence / AIL_init_sequence / AIL_start_sequence / AIL_set_sequence_loop_count inside fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade (BGM track manager: stop/load/init/start, volume + fade, loop count), and read once in fd2_game_options_menu_loop for the live BGM on/off volume toggle.
element_semantics: Single scalar slot holding the AIL sequence handle returned by AIL_allocate_sequence_handle; every access is a full 32-bit dword (writer stores EAX; readers PUSH dword ptr [0x53ED0]).
comment_original_issue: Existing src comment block was accurate and complete, but its datatype prose said 'kept uint32 to match the handle width' while the actual declaration is 'void *' (matching the neighboring bgm_driver_handle comment). Adjusted that one phrase to say 'declared void *' for internal consistency; all other content (writer/readers/BSS reasoning) left intact.
notes: Zero-initialized in image (BSS). Writer is gated on a successful AIL_install_MDI_INI in main (data_fd2_audio_bgm_driver_available_flag set alongside). Ghidra data plate at 0x53ED0 was null/empty; created a concise plate from the src conclusion via run_script_inline + cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT). FD2.LE was modified (plate created); program saved at end of work per Ghidra rules.
